speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You were a line behind the ladies. Navarre comes in on the rhyme, and the rhyme had gone past you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The day was in my mind. I heard them, and I was late.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The yard did not laugh. That is the size of it. Do not carry it heavier than a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will put it in a letter. I will not put it in the book.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Wednesday is the same play. Come in with them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday I will. Today I was behind.
